title: Polizei Berlin erlässt Allgemeinverfügung zum 17. Juni 2026

extraction.summaryEn: Police issued a general order banning public assemblies, marches and rallies at the Memorial for Poland 1939-1945 in Berlin-Mitte on 17 June 2026 to protect the commemoration. The restriction runs from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m.
